messages:
Matt: quick sync—before we update the RFC, want to land on a single 'grace' signal from adapters (soft vs hard). thinking about a small v2 contract so adapters can surface why theysoft-fallback.

Sara: +1. today nil == hard fallback, which hides 'ok-but-not-ideal' cases.

Jin: curious about shape and perf. carrying more metadata could matter at high qps.

Matt: proposal sketch: policy.evaluate(...) returns a flat tuple: status in (accept|soft_fallback|hard_fallback), candidateRoute?, reason_enum?, priority_delta?

Ben: runtime behavior: on soft_fallback we can still route to candidate but tag telemetry and maybe deprioritize. That avoids silent quality drops. :+1:

Carla: prefer a small enum set to avoid drift: capacity_limited, latency_degraded, model_precision_tradeoff, region_outage. freeform debug string allowed but not for metrics.

Sara: agree. telemetry should ingest only enums (sampled strings to logs). also ops wants a soft_fallback_rate metric per tenant/model/region with alerting e.g. >5% for 5m on prod tiers.

Jin: perf note: status a byte, enums as small ints, priority_delta small int. negligible allocation if we keep candidate pointer same.

Ben: migration path? many adapters are v1 returning Optional<Route>.

Matt: runtime will accept both. v1 -> implicit hard_fallback. add a compatibility shim in policy-engine. v2 adapters can emit soft_fallbacks.

Carla: tests: unit reorder tests when soft_fallbacks present; sim to check thrash. also add canary to Dedicated first.

Sara: rollout plan: v2 to Dedicated, run 24h sim with production traces, then staged hosted rollout. I'll prototype adapter types + shim tests (Thu).

Jin: I'll add telemetry fields and sim harness (Fri).

Carla: I'll map existing return paths to enum set and post mapping doc by EOD.

Ben: I'll update policy docs and migration checklist (Mon).

Matt: one open Q: should policy provide priority_delta so SLA overrides are possible?

Jin: propose optional priority_delta:int (negative means promote, positive deprioritize). default 0 for accept, maybe +10 for soft_fallback. runtime should respect tenant SLA and override if SLA==strict.

Sara: sounds good. keep priority_delta optional and small. runtime ignores it for strict SLA.

opssentry-bot: ticket INF-1427 created: "policy-engine adapter v2 + grace-signal rollout" assigned to @Sara @Jin @Carla @Ben.

Matt: thanks. Sara ping when PR is ready and I'll merge the RFC update.

Sara: will do, thx!
